name: NeRF-Supervision
aliases: RGB-sensor-only self-supervised pipeline for dense descriptors
definition: An RGB-only, self-supervised pipeline that uses an optimized NeRF's density field to generate dense correspondence datasets for training object-centric descriptors, reformulating correspondence via a distribution-of-depths formulation instead of a single depth map.
summary: NeRF-Supervision is an RGB-only, self-supervised pipeline that uses a NeRF's density field to generate dense correspondence datasets, enabling robust descriptor training for thin or reflective objects where traditional methods fail.
